address: 3 route du Frenz, Le Frenz, 68820, France
bio: This cosy chalet is set in a landscape of forests and mountains. Christelle proposes her own personal brand of cuisine (savoury éclair filled with porcini mousse, chanterelles in vinegar and cured ham, duck pot au feu with autumn vegetables cooked in broth), while Frédéric carefully selects the wines....
